title: US 35 over Deer Creek | proposed 2026 replacement
source_note: Primary INDOT B-45063 / Des 1900048 proposed 2026 replacement, document 9721578. Source cover and plans describe a 115 ft new crossing; the associated 2025 NBI record describes the older 1931 bridge.
assumptions: Exterior visualization reconstruction of the named design state, not an as-built survey, structural rating or validated finite-element mesh.
No internal reinforcement, prestressing strands, embedded anchors or fabrication holes. Colors identify visualization layers; amber parts identify explicit approximations.
Source PDF page references always address drawings.pdf, an unchanged issued PDF. Supplemental historical pages are separately identified by document ID and local file.
Constructed interfaces and bearing contact checks establish geometric attachment only. Surveyed seats, actual camber, shim thicknesses and installed tolerances remain unknown.
Site terrain, channel solids, riprap individual stones, buried pile tips, full roadside guardrail terminals and nonstructural utility routing are omitted.
Local Z datum is the source flowline elevation 837.11 ft; geometry is not surveyed or georeferenced.
Straight nominal girder lines use a 75 mm center haunch. Nominal integral-bent seats are derived for visual contact; real support rotational restraint is not inferred from bearing display meshes.

source_index.note: Primary drawings.pdf is byte-for-byte identical to the issued source; no combined or newly authored PDF. Supplemental page numbers do not address the primary PDF.

completeness: Whole crossing reconstructed with unresolved detail (amber)

detail_coverage.detail: One 115 ft bearing span; all four dimensioned BT48x49 beams, 8 in deck, 15 degree right skew and full grade. North (Beam 1) is +Y, left of increasing station, and the north end of each bent is up-station (sheets 11, 13, 14; reflected in revision 1.2).

Both integral bents, 8 embedded source steel bearing assemblies, infill, wings and 12 hidden pile display stubs. Seat attachment and end copes remain approximate. Bents centred 7 in along their lines from the bridge centre line (sheet 13); integral concrete flush with the cap span face (sheet 15); wings 12 ft from the span-face corner to the tip (sheets 13, 17). Wing tops at the sheet 17 T/El. on the bent centre line, parallel to the grade; centre closure bays and back faces crowned (revision 1.2).

FC barrier, four approximate TFC transitions, skew-to-square approach slabs and nominal extension/drain envelopes. FC section per sheet 23 section A-A; approach slabs 18'-3"/17'-8" either side of the centre line, square ends at Sta. 1270+76.06 / 1272+43.94, crowned top.
Actual girder camber, end copes, diaphragm designation conflict and exact stagger, buried pile tips, transition hardware, construction joints and site terrain.

known_deviations.deviation: The four TFC transitions keep the generic envelope (7 in toe, one sloped face, height easing to 0.70 m); at the butt joints with the corrected FC railing the traffic faces differ by up to about 0.1 m.
known_deviations.reason: The TFC shape is given by INDOT standard drawings E706-TTFC-01 to -03 and E706-CBRT, which are not part of this plan set.

known_deviations.deviation: The skewed near edge of each approach slab is 25 mm beyond the deck end (q = -/+17.9193 m against -/+17.8943 m), a display joint; the Type IA joint itself has no width in the plan set.
known_deviations.reason: The Type IA joint is detailed in INDOT Standard Drawing E 609-BRJT-01 (sheet 25 note 4), which is not part of this plan set.
